csv_project_name: AE Svc for USACE Great Lakes & Ohio River Division
csv_agency: US Army Corps of Engineers - Detroit District
csv_scope_of_work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is issuing this Sources Sought notice and conducting market research as a means to identify the interest and capabilities of both small and large business entities to provide architect-engineering (A-E) services for the USACE Great Lakes and Ohio River Division (LRD) Civil Works and Interagency and International Services (IIS) programs. The intention is to procure these A-E services through a qualifications-based selection at the task order level with all task orders to be issued as Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) task orders.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Inspection Services, Value Engineering, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: ' *** Time Sensitive *** - Project Number: PANGLR-26-P-00000297- Solicitation documents available online. - THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE
title: A-E Services for USACE Great Lakes and Ohio River Division
short_description: Sources sought for multidisciplinary architect-engineering services under USACE regional task orders.
project_location: Detroit, Michigan, USA; services for the USACE Great Lakes and Ohio River Division region
project_scope: Sources sought notice for an indefinite regional architect-engineering services requirement supporting the USACE Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Civil Works and Interagency and International Services programs. The notice does not define a specific project, structure type, size, span, floor area, or construction package; work is intended to be assigned later through firm-fixed-price task orders.
services: Multidisciplinary architect-engineering services to be procured on a qualifications-based selection basis at task-order level, including architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, inspection services, value engineering, hazardous waste engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a sources sought notice, not a defined project procurement.
- It is a broad regional A-E services requirement rather than a specific bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Structural engineering is included, but only as one discipline among many.
- The notice resembles a framework/IDIQ-style opportunity without technical definition of individual structures.
- No information indicates large spans, lightweight structures, innovation, or architecturally demanding scope relevant to sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. This is not a project-specific tender but a market research notice for future task orders, so no realistic project construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice concerns future firm-fixed-price task orders under a qualifications-based A-E services arrangement, but no contract value, task-order volume, or engineering fee basis is provided.
references_qualifications: Interested firms must demonstrate capability to provide multidisciplinary A-E services for USACE programs. Requested disciplines include architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, inspection, value engineering, hazardous waste engineering, and structural engineering. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Qualifications-based selection at the task-order level; all task orders to be issued as firm-fixed-price. Detailed award weighting is not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Detroit District, Detroit, MI, USA. Contact: Noah Bruck. Phone: 313-226-2657. Fax: 313-226-2209. Email: noah.r.bruck@usace.army.mil. Website: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/a8e742560028427695e866fb705167e3/view
notes: This is explicitly a sources sought notice for market research, not a final tender for a defined project. Target market is listed as General Building. Because the requirement is a broad regional A-E services vehicle for multiple future task orders, it has limited strategic relevance under sbp's preference against framework agreements without technical specification.
